description: Issue a card for a user (POST /cards/v1). card_type VIRTUAL is usable immediately; PHYSICAL enters embossing/shipping and must be activated on receipt. affinity_group_id selects the card program (BIN, art, limits) configured with Pomelo.

address.description: Shipping address for PHYSICAL cards (street_name, street_number, zip_code, city, region, country)

extra.description: Any additional Pomelo card fields, merged into the payload

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. Auto-generated when omitted.

name: create_card
